notes_for_editor: Thin record: two sources only (the Forest Lookouts entry and a TopoQuest place entry). The story runs about 110 words because nothing more was found; it is not padded. Agency and access are unknown and the Forest Lookouts page names no agency, so none is given. Search results kept pointing to Fox Butte (Lake County, Deschutes National Forest, 1933 steel tower with cabin quarters, per a firelookout.com search summary). That is a different site; the page was not read and nothing from it is used. The Fremont National Forest attribution in the brief is not in this source. The record is still missing a Lakeview-area Forest Service lookout history.
